description.value: Table: Summon Monster VIII Creature Subtype(s) Ankheg* [(holy/shadow)] Elemental (Elder) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Garula* [(holy/shadow)] Psycheflayer (Devil, Extraplanar) Megalodon* (Aquatic, [holy/shadow]) T-Rexaur* (Reptilian, [holy/shadow]) This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 8th-level list with a CR rating of 12 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 7th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 6th-level or lower lists.
